entities.summary: Gilad Bloom is a former professional tennis player from Israel. Bloom trained at the Israel Tennis Centers. His career-high rankings were World No. 61 in singles and World No. 62 in doubles. Gilad Bloom was a athletes & competitors from Tel Aviv (b. 1967-03-01, Tel Aviv). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
